scope: P-192 rational prime-order subgroup and general prime-order elliptic curves over finite prime fields
statement: For prime-order E(F_p) of order r, the separable endomorphism 1-Frobenius has degree r and annihilates E(F_p); its dual 1-conjugate-Frobenius acts on E(F_p) by the known scalar 1-p mod r, so neither restriction yields the unknown DLP scalar.
